ns2:section.sectionText: 2 or 4 hours. Long title: Spatial and Temporal Metadata: Theoretical Problems. Open to graduate students campuswide. Day/time to be determined in consultation with enrolled students closer to the beginning of the semester. Contact the instructor (renear@illinois.edu) for details. Requires a good working of first order logic (including proof techniques) and discrete mathematics, and an active professional interest in applying formal methods to problems in information science.
